import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_pipeline_b()
    return nothing
end

function pipeline_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, w, wb, i_n)
    for i_x = 1:i_n
        v[i_x] = u[i_x] ^ 2 + 1.0
    end
    for i_x = 1:i_n
        w[i_x] = v[i_x] * u[i_x]
    end
    for i_x2 = 1:i_n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + w[i_x2]
    end
    for i_x2 = i_n:-1:1
        wb[i_x2] = wb[i_x2] + lossb[1]
    end
    for i_x = i_n:-1:1
        vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * wb[i_x]
        ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * wb[i_x]
        wb[i_x] = 0.0
    end
    for i_x = i_n:-1:1
        ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + (2 * u[i_x]) * vb[i_x]
        vb[i_x] = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_pipeline_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function pipeline_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, w, wb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_1!(i_n, u, v)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_2!(i_n, u, v, w)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_3!(i_n, loss, w)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_4!(i_n, lossb, wb)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_5!(i_n, u, ub, v, vb, wb)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_6!(i_n, u, ub, vb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_1!(i_n, u, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    v[i_x] = u[i_x] ^ 2 + 1.0
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_2!(i_n, u, v, w)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    w[i_x] = v[i_x] * u[i_x]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_3!(i_n, loss, w)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x2 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += w[i_x2]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_4!(i_n, lossb, wb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x2 = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    wb[i_x2] = wb[i_x2] + lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_5!(i_n, u, ub, v, vb, wb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * wb[i_x]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * wb[i_x]
    wb[i_x] = 0.0
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_pipeline_b_6!(i_n, u, ub, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + (2 * u[i_x]) * vb[i_x]
    vb[i_x] = 0.0
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end
